scientific_integrity: Exact stationary position flux is zero; the rare reset-age layer makes the non-uniform integrability explicit. Numerical tests verify finite-dimensional identities, not the limiting proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive trapping, noise-resetting and diffusion rates. Uses the established sharp stationary position-density tail as a premise; no finite-distance uniform error bound or independent scientific audit. Weak velocity convergence does not extend to the first moment.
title: Extreme-position velocity and reset-age boundary layers in a harmonically trapped particle driven by resetting Brownian noise
